# OpenProgram 0.6.2 Release Notes

Original version date: August 15, 2026. This tag addressed the Intel macOS runtime build failure exposed by `v0.6.1`, but complete release verification still failed. It did not publish installable assets.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Restored the macOS x86_64 platform-runtime build entry point.
- Adjusted dependencies and build configuration for the Intel macOS runtime.

## ⚠️ Release status

- Complete dependency compatibility on Intel macOS still did not satisfy the release requirements.
- No GitHub Release or installable runtime assets were published.
- This tag is not an installable user version; all fixes are included in `v0.6.6`.

## 🔄 Version guide

- Previous release attempt: [`v0.6.1`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.1)
- Next release attempt: [`v0.6.3`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.3)
- Installable version: [`v0.6.6`](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/releases/tag/v0.6.6)
